assistworld-assist-world:lever:011acc7d-.title: Import Agent (Air Freight Operations)
assistworld-assist-world:lever:011acc7d-.description: Overview We are seeking highly organized and detail-oriented Remote Import Agents to support a fast-paced air freight operation focused on JFK import recoveries. This role acts as the communication bridge between customers, warehouse teams, dispatch, and drivers — ensuring shipments move efficiently, customers receive timely updates, and operational requests are handled accurately. The environment is repetitive and process-driven, making it ideal for someone who thrives in structured workflows, can prioritize tasks logically, and remains calm under pressure. Key Responsibilities Shipment Coordination & Customer Communication Monitor and respond to shipment-related emails Enter shipment alerts and customer requests into the TMS system Provide shipment updates to customers, dispatch, warehouse teams, and drivers Follow up proactively when updates are delayed Call drivers, dispatch teams, or warehouse staff directly when needed for urgent updates Ensure all communication is accurate, professional, and timely Documentation & Data Entry Enter shipment information into Crown Freight Manager Print and distribute shipment documents and requests Update operational spreadsheets with shipment statuses and customer requests Track and relay warehouse service requests and shipment changes Maintain accurate operational notes and logs Operations Support Coordinate between customers and warehouse/dispatch teams Escalate operational issues appropriately when needed Prioritize urgent shipments based on operational impact Support time-sensitive import recovery workflows Assist with routing instructions and shipment status coordination Workflow & Prioritization Distinguish between urgent and non-urgent tasks Prioritize truckers already waiting on-site over future/pending shipments Ensure high-priority requests are communicated immediately to the operations team Handle repetitive operational processes with consistency and accuracy Systems & Tools Crown Freight Manager (training provided) Cartis (training provided) Outlook Excel & shared spreadsheets RingCentral / VOIP systems Transportation Management Systems (TMS) Required Skills & Experience Previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, dispatch support, trucking coordination, or import operations preferred Strong organizational and multitasking skills Ability to think logically and prioritize effectively Comfortable handling repetitive operational workflows Strong written and verbal English communication Comfortable making calls to drivers, warehouse teams, and customers Strong attention to detail Comfortable working in fast-paced, time-sensitive environments Nice-to-Haves Air import or airport cargo experience Experience working with trucking dispatch teams Familiarity with shipment tracking systems or TMS platforms Experience with customer operations support Understanding of freight terminology (MAWB/HAWB, bonded cargo, etc.) Training & Support Full training provided on proprietary systems and workflows Each remote agent will work directly alongside an on-site operational counterpart Escalation support structure already in place Performance Expectations Fast response times to operational requests Accurate data entry and shipment updates Strong follow-through and communication Ability to manage priorities independently Reliable attendance and shift coverage Industry: Air Freight / Logistics / Import Operations Working Hours (EST): Shift A: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST Shift B: Monday–Wednesday, Friday & Saturday | 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM EST (Off Thursdays & Sundays)

ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:8.title: Regional Outside Sales Specialist, Educational Services - Boston
ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:8.description: This position requires the employee to reside in the Boston, MA area and involves local travel, approximately 80–90% of the time, or 4–5 days per week in the field. Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards! The Regional Outside Sales Specialist, which is formally titled Regional Client Partnership Specialist, Educational Services, is Aya Education’s field leader and plays a central role in expanding our presence within school districts across the region. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong district partnerships, assessing full-scope staffing needs, generating job requests, and identifying opportunities for long-term, scalable workforce solutions. Most of your week will be spent onsite in schools and district offices, meeting with SPED Directors, HR leaders, SELPA administrators, Principals, and other key decision-makers. You’ll serve as the face of Aya Education in your region and help ensure districts have access to qualified special education and therapy professionals who support meaningful outcomes for students from early childhood through age 21. Who We Are: We’re a $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform. At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally. Responsibilities: New Business Development Conduct 5–8 daily walk-ins or 3–4 scheduled meetings with district leaders in order to generate new business Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities within assigned markets Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of target districts in order to win new business Generate new job orders across SPED, paraeducator, therapy, behavioral health, and general education support roles Recognize early indicators that may suggest future MSP opportunities Relationship Building and Account Expansion: Develop strong, long-term partnerships with district leadership Visit clients and prospects 4–5 days per week to build familiarity and deepen relationships Conduct onsite assessments to uncover unmet staffing needs and expand existing accounts Serve as Aya’s local market representative and a trusted partner to district teams Collaboration and Cross-Functional Alignment Partner with Account Managers to ensure job orders are filled quickly and accurately Work closely with internal teams, including Recruitment, AM Leadership, Compliance, and Licensing, to support overall account growth Maintain accurate documentation of walk-ins, meetings, and district insights in HubSpot Educate districts on LotusOne, demonstrate platform value, and support onboarding Field Intelligence and Strategic Insights Track and report on competitive activity, district budget cycles, and hiring trends Identify patterns such as high call-offs, multi-agency usage, inconsistent fill rates, or staffing gaps Use field insights to inform long-term MSP strategy Representation and Events Represent Aya Education at conferences, regional events, and district engagements Deliver polished presentations and talking points tailored to school leadership Increase awareness o

coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:a999923d-6.title: Technical Project Manager
coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:a999923d-6.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalized and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. The Technical Project Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end execution of engineering projects across internal and external stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining alignment with business objectives. This role focuses primarily on managing integrated roadmaps and project plans, Agile process facilitation, and acting as a client-facing point of contact for the projects they oversee. The individual will also promote Agile best practices within their projects helping to facilitate scrum ceremonies, driving prioritization, as well as fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the engineering teams.​
responsibilities: Project Delivery: Ensure end-to-end delivery of technical projects including requirements gathering, milestone planning, technical solutioning, documentation, execution, and final delivery.
Client-facing Lead: Act as the main point of contact for client-facing technical projects, helping to set expectations around scope and timeline and re-prioritizing as needed.
Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate across internal teams (Engineering, Content, Ops/DevOps, Deployment etc.) and client teams to coordinate seamless execution.
Risk & Issue Management: Identify risks early, create mitigation strategies, and resolve project roadblocks with minimal impact.
Stakeholder Engagement: Maintain transparent communication with internal and external stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and challenges.
Tooling & Reporting: Leverage Jira, Confluence, and Asana project dashboards to provide project visibility and performance tracking.
Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements in project delivery processes to drive continuous improvement and scalability
qualifications: Required:
5+ years of experience in project or program management, with technical or digital project experience.
Technical background or understanding of software engineering, infrastructure, and software deployment practices.
Strong experience with Agile methodologies.
Strong experience with Jira, Confluence, and other Agile project tools.
Proven ability to manage distributed and cross-functional teams.
Preferred:
Experience in QSR, digital signage, or retail technology industries.
Familiarity with Content Management platforms.
Experience with API-based software integrations.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:12.title: Equipment Operator
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:12.description: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel, located in Pineville, LA, is looking for experienced Equipment Operators to join our team. Experience operating a forklift in an industrial manufacturing facility is required. A working knowledge of material handling, banding, palletizing, and loading material onto trucks is preferred. The Equipment Operator will perform required operator maintenance on fork trucks. Ability to read and interpret typed reports and schedules is required.
responsibilities: Learns and follows safety regulations.
Takes actions to avoid potential hazards or obstructions, such as other equipment, other workers, or falling objects.
Monitors operations to ensure that health and safety standards are met.
Adjusts handwheels and depresses pedals to control attachments.
Starts engines, moves throttles, switches, or levers, or depresses pedals to operate machines.
Coordinates machine actions with other activities, positioning or moving loads in response to hand or audio signals from team members.
Loads and moves equipment, or other materials, using fork trucks or related equipment.
Checks fuel supplies at sites to ensure adequate availability.
Performs operator maintenance on fork trucks.
Inspects equipment before use.
Locates material using project numbers and piecemarks.
qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Ability to read and interpret typed reports and schedules required.
Certifications or prior experience using moving machinery, such as forklifts, preferred.
Working knowledge of material handling, banding, palletizing, and loading on to truck preferred.
Ability to perform basic operator maintenance on fork trucks required.
Must complete on-site training and demonstrate safe operation of machinery.
Clear Motor Vehicle Report.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:9e3.title: Chef Instructor, Pastry (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:9e3.team: 172 - Highland Village - Sur La Table, 4500 Interstate 55 North Ste 172, Jackson, MS, 39211
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:9e3.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or n

flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:3172.description: Role: Glazier Summary: Install, fit, fabricate unitized curtain wall systems and other architectural products in various sectors including but not limited to industrial, institutional and commercial buildings Benefits: •Dental insurance •Health insurance •Vision insurance •Prescription insurance •Referral bonus program •Overtime pay •Vacation pay •On-site parking •Paid apprenticeship training •Sponsored Retirement Savings Plan •PPE provided •Tools provided •Flynn University (Coach training) Daily responsibilities: • Read and interpret blueprints and specifications for unitized curtain wall systems and other architectural products • Assemble and install prefabricated unitized curtain wall systems, mirrors or glass products on walls and interior/exterior of a building • Install, fit, fabricate and attach architectural metals or related substitute products in industrial, institutional and commercial buildings

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:277d8982-.title: Product Marketing & GTM Lead Manager-Freemium
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:277d8982-.description: ABOUT GEN: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Lead Manager, Product Marketing & GTM – Freemium, is responsible for end-to-end marketing positioning, messaging, launch strategy, and integrated go-to-market execution across the Freemium portfolio (Avast, AVG, Avira, CCleaner). This role sits at the center of Product, Brand, Growth, Analytics, Regional Marketing, and Channel teams—owning the development of differentiated product positioning and ensuring flawless orchestration of launches from strategy through in-market optimization. The role combines product marketing leadership with integrated marketing and GTM execution, ensuring clear storytelling, disciplined launch planning, operational excellence, and measurable business impact. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Product Positioning & Messaging Leadership · Own marketing positioning and messaging for products and launches, crafting clear, compelling, and differentiated product narratives. · Define messaging architecture aligned to target audiences and product strategy. · Develop high-impact product copy, value propositions, key selling points, and feature narratives. · Maintain and evolve foundational product storytelling assets including videos, screenshots, and hero product materials. End-to-End Launch Strategy & GTM Ownership · Define comprehensive launch plans including tiering, target audiences, key messages, acquisition channel mix (DTC and non-DTC), investment levels, and launch cadence. · Own integrated marketing execution as part of GTM, ensuring operational excellence and clear launch choreography. · Partner closely with Product Strategy to ensure marketing execution aligns to broader GTM objectives. · Develop and compile full integrated marketing plans in partnership with commercial teams - including channels, investment, campaign frameworks, calendar, and required assets. Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution · Establishes business goals and objectives of each GTM and ensures plans are built to achieve goals. · Drive and execute cross-functional, integrated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, lifecycle, partner, and regional channels – focusing on the entire end to end customer journey. · Develop foundational launch materials ensuring accurate and compelling representation of product capabilities. Analytics-Driven Planning & Optimization · Partner with Analytics to size opportunities, forecast impact, and define launch KPIs. · Connect launch performance back to the original plan and business objectives. · Monitor in-market results post-launch and coordinate cross-channel learnings. · Continuously optimize messaging, materials, and activation strategies b

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:01246037-fd1.title: Inside Sales Manager
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:01246037-fd1.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies build high-performing teams across executive assistance, administrative support, customer support, sales support, recruiting, operations, and other critical business functions. The Role We’re looking for a hands-on Inside Sales Manager to own the follow-up and mid-funnel layer of our inbound sales engine while raising the quality and consistency of how our entire sales floor sells. You will lead this function, strengthen the systems and processes behind it, coach the team, and ensure every qualified opportunity is managed with discipline and urgency. You will also help establish stronger sales standards across the organization through coaching, performance management, process improvement, and the thoughtful use of sales technology. This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. You will have a team, a modern sales tech stack, and clear revenue and performance targets tied directly to your ownership. Salary: PHP 90,000 to PHP 110,000 per month, plus On-Target Earnings (OTE) Schedule: Pacific Time
responsibilities: What You’ll Own:
Team Leadership
Manage and develop the inbound follow-up team, including SDRs and Sales Associates
Conduct regular 1:1s, coach performance, and hire as the team scales
Own the pairing model between Sales Associates and Account Executives
Establish cadence standards, ownership rules, and CRM hygiene expectations
Manage the Sales Trainer and own onboarding and ramp-up for all new sales hires
Follow-Up and Mid-Funnel Conversion
Design, write, and A/B test follow-up sequences across email and chat
Use reply rate, re-engagement rate, and conversion as your primary scorecards
Build and manage the no-show recovery motion for cancellations and missed demos
Turn missed and cancelled demos into rebooked conversations
Build and run reactivation campaigns for aged and closed-lost opportunities
Reduce stage-to-stage drop-off across the funnel, beginning with the weakest-performing stage
Channel Partner Lead Management
Oversee the handling of leads and opportunities generated through channel partnerships
Establish clear ownership, follow-up, and reporting standards for partner-sourced opportunities
Track channel partner performance and evaluate its effectiveness as a source of new business
Sales Quality and Coaching
Review recorded calls and demos using a written sales scorecard
Maintain a fixed monthly call-review coverage target for every representative
Coach Account Executives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and securing second calls
Run regular calibration sessions to ensure consistent scoring and coaching standards
Join live deals when a representative needs support moving an opportunity forward
Knowledge and Compliance
Own the sales knowledge base as the company’s single source of truth
Maintain the content that powers our AI sales chat assistant
Establish a regular review cadence so customer-facing information remains accurate and current
Ensure claims made by sales representatives and automated channels are accurate and compliant
What You’ll Be Measured On
Demo no-show and cancellation recovery rate
Customer response-time SLA
Deal conversion rate
Sales cycle length
Average contract value per deal
Follow-up reply rate
Touches-per-deal compliance
Second-call booking rate
Stage-to-stage funnel conversion
Demo-to-close rate
Revenue recovered from aged and closed-lost pipeline
Call scorecard coverage, including documented coaching feedback for every representative
qualifications: Requirements
At least 4 years of experience in inside sales, sales development, revenue operations, or a similar commercial role
At least 2 years of experience managing or coaching a sales team
Proven experience improving follow-up, pipeline conversion, show rates, or sales-cycle performance
Strong understanding of inbound sales funnels, lead management, and mid-funnel conversion
Experience coaching sales representatives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and deal progression
Ability to review sales calls, identify performance gaps, and provide clear, actionable feedback
Hands-on experience building sales sequences across email, chat, SMS, or other follow-up channels
Strong CRM discipline and experience working with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
Comfortable using data to diagnose funnel problems, set targets, and manage performance
Strong written and verbal English communication skills
Willingness and ability to work Pacific Time hours
Preferred
Experience managing both SDRs or Sales Associates and Account Executives
Experience owning sales onboarding, training, and rep ramp-up programs
Experience building no-show recovery, closed-lost reactivation, or aged-pipeline campaigns
Familiarity with AI-enabled sales tools, conversation intelligence, and sales automation platforms
Experience working in a high-growth startup, SaaS, staffing, outsourcing, or technology-enabled services company
Experience managing leads generated through channel partnerships
Familiarity with compliance, sales claims management, and maintaining a customer-facing knowledge base

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e9d119a0-4c5b-.title: Engineering Manager, Data Modeling
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e9d119a0-4c5b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Engineering Manager, Data Modeling based in Canada. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role focused on building the foundational data layer that powers decision-making across a growing SaaS environment.
